title: Closed-Form Arbitrary-Gap Rényi Nonadditivity Above Any Positive Order via Direct Products of Free Groups and High-Girth Graphs
summary: We give a closed-form finite-dimensional construction of quantum channels with real algebraic entries exhibiting arbitrarily large violations of minimum-output Rényi entropy additivity uniformly above any prescribed positive Rényi order, using a different finite realization based on direct products of free groups and fixed-field high-girth graphs. More precisely, for every $p_0>0$ and $g>0$, we construct one channel and one Bell input for which the additivity gap is greater than $g$ simultaneously for all $p\in[p_0,\infty]$. With $r=\lceil2g\rceil$, the construction uses $15r$ output qubits…
